title: Info board
description: The essentials at a glance: a few labelled facts, or where each part of a story stands.

label.description: What the tile is about: "Cost", "Opens", "Airport". The label carries the topic, and may hold the fuller phrase the value shortens — "Morgan Stanley: data-centre revenue" as the label, "Down ~10%" as the value.

value.description: The fact itself, as short as possible: "$48 million", "Closed". The value is the punch — a number, a word, a few words — never a sentence. At most 6 Chinese characters: Chinese has no word boundaries, so a longer Chinese value wraps mid-phrase on a phone. Put the sentence in the label or the note.

tone.description: Optional status colour. Use it for states (open, closed, under review), never to judge a fact. The value must say the status in words too.
